title: Closeout contract repair: one version-aware proof contract for pre-merge and post-merge gates

sha_binding.verified_source_note: This is the exact substantive branch head for the strategy-aware main-reference correction. Post-merge migration receipt binding requires a caller-supplied GitHub API attestation whose merge SHA equals the verified source and whose PR head equals or has a proof-only branch ancestry path from the receipt. The validator first checks whether the attested original PR head is an ancestor of the attested merge SHA. A real two-parent merge commit uses merge_sha^1 as the pre-merge main reference, with merge-shape and parent-order guards; a disjoint squash or rebase history uses the merge base of the attested head and merge SHA. Branch-side and direct ancestry paths then use the net tree diff from receipt to target, and each non-proof path must have the same blob at the target and the strategy-selected main reference. Missing attestation, repository context, commits, parent or merge-base identity, or main-side files; anomalous single-parent or parent-ordered merges; unrelated histories; and lane-authored non-proof deltas all fail closed. Commits after this anchor are restricted to UTV2-1720 proof artifacts; evidence_commit_sha and current_pr_head_sha are resolved by CI at validation time. Post-merge closeout rebinds the proof artifacts to the authoritative merge SHA.

required_scenarios: schema-v1 bundles fail pre-merge and remain readable only in the explicit post-merge historical context
migration receipt head exact-match passes pre-merge and mismatches fail by named code
squash-shaped migration binding passes only when the GitHub API attests both the rebound merge SHA and the original merged PR head SHA
post-merge branch-side or direct ancestry passes only after Git verifies ancestry and a net-tree non-proof delta matches the blob at the strategy-selected main-side reference
a two-parent merge commit uses its first parent as pre-merge main, rejects lane-authored non-proof drift, and accepts proof-only rebinds plus an independent main advance
a single-parent merge-like successor that contains the original PR head fails migration_receipt_ancestry_unverified
a main-imported file whose target blob equals the computed main-side blob passes, while a lane-authored changed or new non-proof file fails migration_receipt_non_proof_delta
a three-commit branch replayed onto advanced main by rebase fails migration_receipt_non_proof_delta when its middle commit introduced a lane-authored non-proof file
missing attestation, unavailable commits, Git errors, stale non-proof deltas, unrelated heads, and merge-attestation mismatches fail closed
modeling and data-canonical lanes require app-runtime queries and row_counts while governance remains static
